v1PreflightOnly: eval/a99-closed-loop/structured-evidence-context-v1/DOC-0252 (topology-sanity-report.v1.json) is historical-only and was NOT executed against any model; only V2 was executed.

providerCalls.note: Haiku ran as a blind subagent classification, not an OpenRouter/provider transport call.

preRegisteredNamedObservations.qwenAgendaUnderFull: Qwen answers ITEM-CCE2C592 (Agenda) as DOCUMENT_LABEL under FULL_CONTEXT, wrong 3/3 -> question was: does V2 return STRUCTURAL_UNIT?
preRegisteredNamedObservations.haikuF1UnderFull: Haiku answers ITEM-505430BB (F1) as NON_STRUCTURAL/STRUCTURAL_UNIT under FULL_CONTEXT, wrong 0/3 -> question was: does V2 return DOCUMENT_LABEL?

consideredCases.A: STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_CROSS_MODEL_BENEFIT_SUPPORTED - both models' target failure fixed, zero control regressions in either model.
consideredCases.E: STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_TRADEOFF_OBSERVED - improvement is real but a new control regression appears in at least one model.

caseClassification.actualOutcome: Both models show real, partial improvement on their own pre-identified failure item (Qwen Agenda 0/3->2/3; Haiku F1 0/3->2/3), and neither model reaches full 3/3 stability on that item. Case A is excluded because Haiku's previously-stable Agenda control regressed (3/3 -> 2/3). Cases B/C/D are excluded because both models did improve on their target item. Case E's condition (real improvement + a new control regression in at least one model) is met by Haiku's Agenda regression.

interpretation: Reorganizing FULL_CONTEXT's identical source content into a neutral PAGE->BLOCK->ATOM hierarchy (FULL_STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_V2) partially recovers the semantic-role decision each model was individually getting wrong under flat FULL_CONTEXT: Qwen's Agenda hierarchy confusion and Haiku's F1 metadata-vs-title confusion both move toward the correct label, without either model's improvement being complete (both remain 2/3, not 3/3). This supports SEMANTIC_SCOPE_ORGANIZATION_CAUSALLY_CONTRIBUTES in a weak/partial sense and weakens (without eliminating) CONTEXT_LENGTH_ALONE_EXPLANATION, since content length was held exactly constant between FULL_CONTEXT and FULL_STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_V2 and only organization changed. However, the result is not a clean win: Haiku's previously rock-stable Agenda answer (STRUCTURAL_UNIT, 3/3 under FULL_CONTEXT and under the earlier MINIMAL/LOCAL confirmation) flipped to NON_STRUCTURAL on exactly one of three repeats under V2. This is a genuine new instability introduced by the structured presentation for at least one model, not a pre-existing failure being fixed. The correct, non-overreaching conclusion is that neutral hierarchical presentation causally contributes to recovering some lost semantic-role accuracy on this frozen DOC-0252 cohort, under these tested models and this configuration, at the cost of introducing a new (so far single-repeat) instability elsewhere. It does not license 'structured context is better' as a general or production claim, and does not generalize beyond DOC-0252 or beyond qwen/qwen3.7-flash and Haiku under this exact prompt/schema.
doesNotEstablish: That FULL_STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_V2 is production-ready or should replace FULL_CONTEXT.
That structured presentation is universally beneficial across documents, models, or item types.
That the Agenda regression in Haiku is a stable property of V2 rather than repeat-level noise (n=3 per arm; only one repeat differs).
scope: DOC-0252 only, one document, two models (Qwen, Haiku). Not evidence about the remaining corpus.
